risk_register.label: Regulatory compliance risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: governance_compliance final_score=6.46 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will conduct quarterly reviews of their governance and compliance policies to ensure alignment with regulatory requirements, leveraging their existing governance_compliance score of 6.46 as a benchmark.
fashion_extensions_applied: Personalisation profiling requires explicit consent — not implied by purchase history alone under UK GDPR
Automated pricing decisions may require human review disclosure under the UK AI Bill 2026

risk_register.label: Staff adoption risk
risk_register.trigger_reason: staff_digital_literacy final_score=7.22 vs thresholds HIGH<4.0 MEDIUM<6.0
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will develop targeted training programs for staff to enhance their digital literacy, building on their existing staff_digital_literacy score of 7.22, to ensure they can effectively utilize Shopify's features and tools.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: UK Data Protection Act 2018: Staff Training and Awareness
fashion_extensions_applied: Longer-serving retail staff may resist AI-assisted product recommendations if they perceive it as undermining their styling expertise
Owner-manager resistance is the single strongest predictor of failed AI adoption in fashion SMEs

risk_register.label: Vendor dependency risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will negotiate a service-level agreement with Klaviyo to ensure timely support and minimize the risk of vendor dependency, particularly in light of their marketing automation tools detected on the Shopify platform.
fashion_extensions_applied: Shopify platform dependency — significant portions of Agent 2 recommendations assume Shopify, creating risk if the business migrates platforms
Single marketing automation vendor lock-in — if Klaviyo is the only tool, all customer communication is at risk from a single vendor decision

risk_register.label: AI accuracy and hallucination risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will implement AI model explainability and transparency measures to mitigate the risk of AI accuracy and hallucination, particularly given their existing governance_compliance score of 6.46 and lack of a chat widget.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: EU AI Ethics Guidelines: Explainability and Transparency
fashion_extensions_applied: AI-generated size advice that is wrong drives returns rather than reducing them — directly counterproductive to the primary use case
AI-generated product descriptions containing incorrect material composition create trading standards liability

risk_register.label: Ethical and bias risk
risk_register.mitigation: Lucy & Yak will conduct regular bias and fairness audits on their AI systems, leveraging their existing governance_compliance score of 6.46 and privacy policy mentions of AI, to ensure ethical and unbiased decision-making.
risk_register.regulatory_ref: EU AI Ethics Guidelines: Bias and Fairness
fashion_extensions_applied: Sizing bias — AI sizing recommendations trained primarily on standard UK size data may underserve plus-size, petite or non-standard body types who represent a majority of real customers
Fast-fashion sustainability — AI demand forecasting optimised purely for sell-through rate may conflict with the business's sustainability commitments or consumer expectations around overconsumption

phase2_deploy_built.justification: Automated Review Collection is specifically right for Lucy & Yak right now because it will help them manage the influx of online reviews and maintain brand authenticity, addressing their primary challenge of rapid growth in online sales.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_yotpo
deliverables.content: To configure Yotpo for Lucy & Yak, navigate to the Shopify app store, search for Yotpo, and click 'Get' to install. Once installed, click 'Configure' and select the review collection template that best suits Lucy & Yak's brand voice and style. Set up the automated review collection sequence to send post-purchase emails or SMS to customers, timed to arrive once the item has likely been worn.
